title: PostReady: PR #601 — Fix captions to expand on-image text, not describe the artwork
description: Fixed a bug where text-on-image posts got captions that described the visual design (e.g. 'Bold simplicity speaks volumes') instead of expanding on the on-image message (e.g. 'Still posting at midnight?'). Captions now correctly riff on the text content of the post.

title: PostReady: PR #599 — Trim dashboard header + six rotating hero lines
description: Dashboard header trimmed for cleaner UX, and the landing page hero now cycles through six rotating headline variants to improve engagement.

title: PostReady: PR #598 — Snap→Post: camera button, HEIC→JPEG, photo-first mobile
description: Added a Take a Photo button (mobile-only) that opens the device camera directly via capture="environment". Also added client-side HEIC→JPEG conversion via heic2any to fix iPhone photo upload failures.

title: PostReady: PR #597 — Stream dashboard shell, fold billing into profile query
description: Performance improvement: getProfile() now fetches plan_status and subscription_period_end together, eliminating a serial Supabase round trip before the first byte of the dashboard shell is streamed.

title: PostReady: PR #595 — Write another caption button
description: Added a "Write another caption" button so users can regenerate captions inline without restarting the creation flow, improving iteration speed.

title: PostReady: PR #594 — Fix metrics collector IG reach call + Graph error visibility
description: Fixed the Instagram metrics collector — IG reach API call corrected and Graph API errors are now surfaced with visibility, improving reliability of the post analytics cron job.

title: PostReady: PR #593 — Onboarding requires business name + auto-generates first post
description: Onboarding now requires a business name before proceeding, and automatically generates the first post during setup to reduce time-to-value.

title: PostReady: PR #592 — Weekly digest email (the retention loop)
description: Added a Monday-morning weekly digest email per active client showing reach, engagement, top post, pack usage, and days since last post.

title: PostReady: PR #591 — Post analytics (metrics collection cron + pack Results card)
description: Added post analytics infrastructure: a metrics collection cron job and a pack Results card so users can see performance data for their published posts.

title: PostReady: PR #590 — Prompt-based text-intent detection routes to text model
description: Added prompt-based text-intent detection that automatically routes text-heavy prompts to the appropriate text model, improving output quality for text-centric content.
